versions.changelog:
- Minor update to documentation formatting in SKILL.md
- The external link for more skills is now presented on a separate line for clarity

- Updated description and wording for clarity and conciseness.
- Added metadata block to the skill definition.
- Changed heading levels and structure for consistency.
- Removed the sample file: skill-card.md.

- Initial release of skill-terminology.
- Provides a centralized collection of UML-related terms, aliases, translations, and abbreviations.
- Emphasizes a modification restriction: files in skill-terminology must not be altered manually.
- For UML definitions, refers users to references/uml.md.
- Linked to more skills at https://github.com/lentiancn/skills.
